How about the Youtube Downloader?

https://rg3.github.io/youtube-dl/

It even does playlists. It even does audio extraction only.

(Open Command Prompt in the directory you put this in after downloading it by holding shift -> right clicking in the explorer window with nothing selected -> clicking Open Command Window here):

youtube-dl <URL to Youtube Video, i.e. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KMwhGE0vd-w as an example>

That'sit.jpg

How to do a playlist:

youtube-dl <URL to Youtube Playlist>

How to do only a portion of a playlist:

youtube-dl --playlist-start 12 --playlist-end 24 <URL to Youtube Playlist>

Note: Either the playlist must be unlisted/public, or you have to provide a username/password with the following:

-u, --username USERNAME Login with this account ID
-p, --password PASSWORD Account password. If this option is left
 out, youtube-dl will ask interactively.

There are tons of options to configure it how you want.

Here is how to get Audio Only (Note, this requires LAME be installed for MP3, or whatever audio codec for whatever format you want):

-x, --extract-audio Convert video files to audio-only files
 (requires ffmpeg or avconv and ffprobe or
 avprobe)

Here's what can be used for making MP3s of your favorite videos:

youtube-dl -x --audio-format MP3 --audio-quality 192K --embed-thumbnail --add-metadata <Playlist URL>

It should dump all the downloaded files into the same place the application is.

Note: This works with other websites too, but I've never used it for that.

If we assume, that instead of the mind and matter duality, there exists only mind as the materia prima, then everything would be consciousness. Of course, not necessarily conscious. What we mean with 'being conscious' ist 'having ego awareness'. Not everything has ego awareness, obviously.

Now, the analogy I like to use, is the one of a dream. You may have heard it already.

Just as in a dream, you are subject and object. Even if you believe that there is a degree of seperation between you and your surroundings in the dream, in the end, all of it is happening inside your mind.

Now, if you take that analogy and apply it to reality, where the one 'dreaming' is the materia prima, and everything happening is part of it, existing under the illusion of seperation, you have a working model of monistic idealism, without unproveable things like an objective world, that is required under realism.

Another thing to consider is, why does brain activity go down if you ingest psilocybin mushrooms?
http://www.pnas.org/content/109/6/2138.abstract
If your own experience of reality intensifies, as in a trip, you would expect brain activity to increase, as it would with a computer.
It would need more RAM to process what is happening.
Instead, brain activity goes down, which implies, that ego awaress may not be generated by the brain.

What I think is happening, is, that the brain is acting like a valve, blocking out 99,9% of all of reality, and only letting in a glimpse of it trough. Now, if you put a wrench into this delicate system, like with psychedelics, an accident, or disease, the valve may open a bit more, and let something through which you shouldn't be able to see. That would imply, that there should be a way to sometimes acquire special abilities after brainsurgery or traumatic brian injury. Well, that's a thing. 'Acquired Savant Syndrome'. http://www.traumaticbraininjury.net/acquired-savant-syndrome-and-tbi/

I'd just want you to consider, that maybe you are not trapped in your head. There are very valid reasons and arguments, why your mind may not be trapped in your body, but instead your body may be made out of and be in 'mind'.

If you have any arguments against this, I am very happy to hear them! :D
